title: 第7章 初展地级武技第8章 声东击西
content_zh:
“马上给住手！”
秦玄怒吼着冲进去，直接将两扇大门给崩碎。
“哥哥，救我！”
看见秦玄的身影，被五花大绑的秦灵儿忍不住嘶哑着哭喊，很是凄惨。
“不好，秦玄来了！”
小胖子孙有才惊呼一声，闪身躲到父亲孙广德身后，惊惧道：“父亲，现在怎么办？”
“哼，一个丹田破碎的废物而已，有什么好怕的？”
孙广德冷笑，丝毫不在意秦玄的到来，反倒是趾高气扬的冲着秦玄冷笑：“秦玄，看在天星门的份儿，本长老可以放你一马，赶紧滚，别影响我爷俩的兴趣。
放心，待得我们爷俩快活过后，可以让你后面也好好快活一下，毕竟像你妹妹这样水灵灵的人儿，相信你也很想玩一玩吧。”
显然，这孙家父子二人有着极为变态的恶趣味。
“给我去死！”
秦玄怒火冲天，杀了过去。
一掌打出，孙广德被杀了一个措手不及，身子倒飞出去，落在地上大口咳血。
看着胸口破碎的护心镜，孙广德失声惊呼：“不可能，你怎么还有修为？”
要不是有这面特殊炼制的护心镜保护自己，刚才就被杀了。
可秦玄不是丹田被废了么，怎么恢复过来了？
眼见着秦玄杀气腾腾地再度冲上来，孙广德惊惧不已，急忙开口：“秦玄，地元宗的朱长老可是本长老的拜把子兄弟，你要是杀了我，他肯定不会放过你的。”
“他若敢来找我麻烦，我便灭了整个地元宗！”
来到孙广德身前，秦玄手起剑落，一颗脑袋横飞出去，重重砸在地上。
死时，眼睛瞪得大大的，兀自不敢置信，自己居然被杀了。

“你……你竟然敢杀我父亲！
朱叔叔是不会放过你的。”
孙有才大恐惊呼一声，然而裤裆前后立马湿漉漉一大片，显然吓得直接失禁了。
秦玄提剑，朝着孙有才走了过去，寒声道：“你不用担心，马上就送你去见你爹！”
“不，秦玄，你不能杀我，你不能杀我！”
孙有才大喊，爬起身子就不要命的朝着外面跑去。
“想跑？”
秦玄冷哼一声，力量汇聚于掌心，朝着孙有才打出一掌。
可就在这个时候，一道人影突然窜了上来，一团元力打出，帮孙有才接下了这一击。
两道元力碰撞，顿时劲风四起，整个房间都猛烈摇晃起来。
来者体态修长，长相俊帅，然而面目严峻如阎罗，自有一股威严。
“秦星穹！”
秦玄双眸虚眯，认出了来者。
秦星穹，与他同岁，同样天赋超绝，只不过当初被秦玄压盖一线，成为秦家年轻一辈第二。
如今，秦玄被废，他自然趁势崛起，成为秦家年轻一辈第一人。
当看见地上的无头尸体，秦星穹又惊又怒：“秦玄，你疯了，竟敢杀孙家三长老，可知这是在给秦家招惹天大的灾祸！”
content_en:
"Stop it now!"
Qin Xuan roared and rushed in, directly shattering the two doors.
"Brother, save me!"
Seeing Qin Xuan's figure, Qin Ling'er, who was tied up with five flowers, couldn't help but cry hoarsely, feeling very miserable.
"No, Qin Xuan is here!"
The fat little boy Sun Youcai exclaimed, hid behind his father Sun Guangde, and said in fear: "Father, what should we do now?"
"Hmph, he's just a piece of trash with a broken Dantian. What's there to be afraid of?"
Sun Guangde sneered, not caring about Qin Xuan's arrival at all, but sneered at Qin Xuan arrogantly: "Qin Xuan, for the sake of Tianxing Sect, I can let you go, get out of here, don't affect our interest.
Don't worry, after we are happy, we can make you happy too. After all, for a person like your sister, I believe you also want to have some fun. "
Obviously, the Sun family father and son have extremely perverted and evil tastes.
"Go to hell!"
Qin Xuan was furious and killed him.
With a palm strike, Sun Guangde was caught off guard. His body flew out and fell to the ground, coughing up blood.
Looking at the broken breast shield on his chest, Sun Guangde exclaimed: "Impossible, how can you still cultivate?"
If it weren't for this specially crafted heart mirror to protect him, he would have been killed just now.
But wasn't Qin Xuan's Dantian destroyed? How did he recover?
Seeing Qin Xuan charging forward again with murderous intent, Sun Guangde was frightened and said hurriedly: "Qin Xuan, Elder Zhu of Diyuan Sect is my elder brother. If you kill me, he will definitely not let you go."
"If he dares to come to me and cause trouble, I will destroy the entire Diyuan Sect!"
Arriving in front of Sun Guangde, Qin Xuan raised his sword and brought down his head. His head flew out and hit the ground heavily.
When he died, his eyes were wide open and he couldn't believe that he was actually killed.
"You...you dare to kill my father!
Uncle Zhu will not let you go. "
Sun Youcai screamed in fear, but his crotch immediately became wet, and he was obviously so frightened that he became incontinent.
Qin Xuan raised his sword and walked towards Sun Youcai, saying in a cold voice: "Don't worry, I will send you to see your father right away!"
"No, Qin Xuan, you can't kill me, you can't kill me!"
Sun Youcai shouted, got up and ran outside desperately.
"Want to run?"
Qin Xuan snorted coldly, gathered his strength in his palm, and struck Sun Youcai.
But at this moment, a figure suddenly rushed up and shot out a ball of energy, helping Sun Youcai take the blow.
The two elements collided, and strong winds suddenly began to rise, causing the entire room to shake violently.
The visitor has a slender figure and a handsome appearance, but his face is as serious as Yama, with a majestic air of its own.
"Qin Xingqiong!"
Qin Xuan narrowed his eyes and recognized the person.
Qin Xingqiong was the same age as him and also extremely talented, but he was surpassed by Qin Xuan at the beginning and became the second among the younger generation of the Qin family.
Now that Qin Xuan was deposed, he naturally took advantage of the situation to rise and become the number one member of the younger generation of the Qin family.
When he saw the headless corpse on the ground, Qin Xingqiong was shocked and angry: "Qin Xuan, you are crazy. You dare to kill the third elder of the Sun family. You know you are causing a huge disaster for the Qin family!"
